description: Xolotl: run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, all 552B, as a local coding agent on one gaming PC (RTX 4090 + 110 GB RAM): ~33 tok/s on agent tasks, ~41 in fast mode, 512K context. Plus GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8 and LFM3-Omni. MoE experts tiered across VRAM, pinned RAM and NVMe, with Xolotl Direct NVMe->VRAM. OpenAI + Anthropic API.
